method: Full 512 frozen Maia 3 features and browser SGD

protocol.target: softmax(legal base logits + shared JavaScript personality scores)
protocol.split: Separate source games, every canonical board input unique across all splits
protocol.limitation: Synthetic soft preferences, not human copying or measured playing strength

meaning: Lower held out teacher KL and increased requested score, also at nearby settings and on autonomous visited boards. Not perfect imitation or measured Elo.

protocol.ordering: Fewer active traits first, then larger base JS. Greedy distinctness, no target count.
protocol.games: Reconstructed complete PGNs, paired colors clustered by opening. Shared JavaScript move features.
protocol.limitation: Exploratory curation. Existing test boards now also select the catalog. Fresh autonomous openings provide a separate confirmation, not Elo or human imitation.
